source_reference: Cold-Chain Cargo Transport Handbook, Section 6.1, p. 84
query_text: What fresh-air exchange rate is specified for refrigerated lemons, and should ventilation be intermittent?
answer_text: Maintain fresh-air exchange at 15 m³/h and keep ventilation continuous. The passage does not specify intermittent ventilation.
handbook_passage: For refrigerated lemons, maintain fresh-air exchange at 15 m³/h. Keep ventilation continuous during carriage; intermittent ventilation is not specified for this cargo.
